# TentoUI

> AntDesign-patterned Blazor UI Component Library styled with Tailwind CSS v4 for .NET 10.

## Overview
- Framework: .NET 10 Blazor (InteractiveServer, InteractiveWebAssembly, InteractiveAuto)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4 CSS-first engine with `@theme` bridge and design tokens
- Component Catalog: 65+ components (General, Layout, Navigation, Data Entry, Data Display, Feedback)

## Quick Start
```bash
dotnet add package TentoUI
npm install -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/cli
```

In `Program.cs`:
```csharp
builder.Services.AddTentoUI();
```

In `_Imports.razor`:
```razor
@using TentoUI
@using TentoUI.Configuration
```

In `Styles/app.tailwind.css`:
```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "../tailwind/tentoui/tentoui.theme.css";
@source "../tailwind/tentoui/tentoui.classes.txt";
@source "../Components/**/*.razor";
@source "../Pages/**/*.razor";
```

In `<head>`:
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="_content/TentoUI/tentoui.min.css" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="css/tailwind.min.css" />
<script src="_content/TentoUI/tentoui.js"></script>
```

In `MainLayout.razor`:
```razor
<ModalHost />
<NotificationHost />
<MessageHost />
```

## AI Agent Skills
Run in your project root:
```bash
dotnet msbuild -t:TentoUIInstallSkills
```
This unpacks `tentoui-components` and `tentoui-tailwind-setup` skills for AI agents.

## Core Component Types & References
- Buttons: Button, FloatButton, BackTop
- Typography: Title, Text, Paragraph, Link
- Layout: Grid (Row, Col), Layout (Header, Sider, Content, Footer), Space, Divider
- Navigation: Menu, Dropdown, Tabs, Pagination, Steps, Breadcrumb, Anchor, Affix
- Data Entry: Input, InputNumber, TextArea, Select, AutoComplete, Checkbox, Radio, Switch, DatePicker, TimePicker, ColorPicker, Slider, Rate, Upload, Transfer, Cascader, TreeSelect, Form
- Data Display: Table, Card, List, Descriptions, Tree, Collapse, Carousel, Image, Calendar, Badge, Avatar, Tag, Statistic, QRCode, Segmented, Watermark, Empty, Popover, Tooltip
- Feedback: Modal, Drawer, Alert, Message, Notification, Popconfirm, Progress, Result, Skeleton, Spin, Tour
